w5-a-692eab60.zh: 机械博物馆！三百多台老游戏机，玩一台抓娃娃？
w5-a-692eab60.en: The Musée Mécanique! Over 300 old machines — try the claw?

w5-a-20bfa352.en: Five quarters. Line it up, then grab!

w5-a-778c7dc0.en: So close! Line it up a bit more.

w5-a-5248e608.zh: 新的纪念品！又多收集了一种！
w5-a-5248e608.en: A new souvenir for the collection!

w5-a-d8e1d8a4.zh: 八种纪念品全抓齐了！你是抓娃娃大师！
w5-a-d8e1d8a4.en: All eight souvenirs! You’re a claw master!

w5-a-c20171ba.zh: 旁边的算命婆婆也想跟你说句话～
w5-a-c20171ba.en: The fortune teller next door wants a word too!

w5-a-b38115d4.zh: 这里的机器都吃 25 美分硬币，进门不要钱！
w5-a-b38115d4.en: The machines here take quarters — and walking in is free!

w5-a-416727f0.zh: 最老的一台是 1884 年的，比金门大桥还老！
w5-a-416727f0.en: The oldest machine here is from 1884 — older than the Golden Gate Bridge!

w5-a-89e99fc1.zh: 这些机器 2002 年才从海边的悬崖屋搬到 45 号码头。
w5-a-89e99fc1.en: These machines moved from the Cliff House to Pier 45 in 2002.

w5-a-5a04c263.zh: 好多人在 7 号码头捞螃蟹！我们也放个网试试？
w5-a-5a04c263.en: People crab off Pier 7! Shall we drop a net?

w5-a-7959d7a5.zh: 放网！等螃蟹闻到饵爬进来～
w5-a-7959d7a5.en: Net down! Wait for the crabs to smell the bait…

w5-a-5c057864.zh: 绳子在动！螃蟹进网啦，快拉！
w5-a-5c057864.en: The rope’s twitching — crabs in the net, pull!

w5-a-893672b0.zh: 拉早啦，螃蟹还没进来呢～
w5-a-893672b0.en: Too early — no crabs in yet.

w5-a-aec5cba8.zh: 拉晚了，饵被吃光，螃蟹走掉了～
w5-a-aec5cba8.en: Too late — the bait’s gone and so are the crabs.

w5-a-d14a5c34.zh: 拉慢了，有螃蟹从网边溜走了！
w5-a-d14a5c34.en: Too slow — one scuttled off the net!

w5-a-10b83d1a.zh: 量一量：够大的留下，太小的放回去！
w5-a-10b83d1a.en: Measure them: keepers stay, small ones go back!

w5-a-25182d00.zh: 这是珍宝蟹！在旧金山湾里一只都不能带走，放回去！
w5-a-25182d00.en: A Dungeness! In San Francisco Bay they always go back!

w5-a-bcc6583c.zh: 石蟹不到 4 英寸，放回去长大吧～
w5-a-bcc6583c.en: A rock crab under 4 inches goes back to grow!

w5-a-482d1993.zh: 这只石蟹够 4 英寸了！
w5-a-482d1993.en: This rock crab is over 4 inches!

w5-a-dc695d4d.zh: 量好了，拍张照——都放回海里啦！
w5-a-dc695d4d.en: Measured and photographed — and all back in the bay!

w5-a-020cb6aa.zh: 在加州的公共码头钓鱼捞螃蟹，不用执照！
w5-a-020cb6aa.en: On a California public pier, you don’t need a fishing licence!

w5-a-b2f94b25.zh: 闻到酸面包的香味了！我们也来捏一个？
w5-a-b2f94b25.en: Smell that sourdough! Shall we shape one?

w5-a-4338aef0.zh: 先揉面：跟着节拍折过来、压下去！
w5-a-4338aef0.en: Knead first: fold and press on the beat!

w5-a-db6f18d1.zh: 选个形状！码头的面包师会捏螃蟹和乌龟！
w5-a-db6f18d1.en: Pick a shape! The Wharf bakers make crabs and turtles!

w5-a-3fab2d6f.zh: 划几刀，面包才会漂亮地裂开！
w5-a-3fab2d6f.en: Score it, so it opens up nicely in the oven!

w5-a-a35821dc.zh: 进烤箱！颜色金黄就拿出来！
w5-a-a35821dc.en: Into the oven! Out when it’s golden!

w5-a-ecac118d.zh: 还有点白，再烤一会儿就好了～
w5-a-ecac118d.en: A little pale — a bit longer next time.

w5-a-2de97f72.zh: 烤得有点黑啦，不过闻着好香！
w5-a-2de97f72.en: A bit dark — but it smells great!

w5-a-44f5a821.zh: 1849 年淘金热的时候，酸面包就是旧金山的日常面包了。
w5-a-44f5a821.en: Since the 1849 Gold Rush, sourdough has been San Francisco’s everyday bread.

w5-a-7e8dde5d.zh: 酸面包里有一种细菌，名字就叫“旧金山”！
w5-a-7e8dde5d.en: There’s a bacterium in sourdough named after San Francisco!

w5-k-2aa6fb42.zh: 这条线今天没开，我们走过去吧！
w5-k-2aa6fb42.en: That line isn't running today — let's walk!

w5-k-2e87c7f2.zh: 提前下车啦，我们走过去！
w5-k-2e87c7f2.en: Off early — we walk from here!

w5-k-257c510d.zh: 就在这儿降落啦，我们走过去！
w5-k-257c510d.en: We landed here — let’s walk the rest!

w5-k-7c88ffac.en: A car is coming. Let’s step aside

w5-k-2a49803a.zh: 这段路有点难走，你来带路吧！
w5-k-2a49803a.en: This bit is tricky — you steer for a moment!

w5-k-169f9235.zh: 坐过一站再下车，才算坐过哦
w5-k-169f9235.en: Ride at least one stop and it counts as a ride

w5-k-deef4cff.zh: 坐到下一站再下车，才算坐过 F 线电车哦
w5-k-deef4cff.en: Ride to the next stop and it counts as a streetcar ride

w5-k-4b1387ba.zh: 差一点！再来一竿，这次一定行～
w5-k-4b1387ba.en: So close! One more cast — you’ve got this~

w5-k-9124e340.en: Not yet — wait for the bite!

w5-k-9ae1d629.zh: 上车啦！上层前排视野最好，每一站我都给你讲
w5-k-9ae1d629.en: All aboard! The front of the top deck has the best view, and I’ll tell you about every stop

w5-k-00c99efb.zh: 叮当车在等我们让路呢，往路边站一站吧
w5-k-00c99efb.en: The cable car is waiting for us. Let’s step to the side

w5-k-d3e5f745.zh: 电车在等我们让路呢，往路边站一站吧
w5-k-d3e5f745.en: The streetcar is waiting for us. Let’s step to the side

w5-k-831da4b9.zh: 观光巴士在等我们让路呢，往路边站一站吧
w5-k-831da4b9.en: The tour bus is waiting for us. Let’s step to the side

w5-k-91a6801c.zh: 轻轨在等我们让路呢，往路边站一站吧
w5-k-91a6801c.en: The train is waiting for us. Let’s step to the side

w5-k-3f22bdb5.zh: 拍得真好！这张可以当明信片了。
w5-k-3f22bdb5.en: Great shot — that could be a postcard!

w5-k-7538cb4b.zh: 这段地铁比较长，想快点可以点「直接到站」。
w5-k-7538cb4b.en: A long Metro leg — tap Skip to stop to get there sooner.

w5-a-b2601524.zh: 最近的观景点我标出来啦，跟着标记走吧！
w5-a-b2601524.en: I’ve marked the nearest lookout — just follow the pin!

w5-k-7755a76a.en: Follow me — I’ll take you there!

w5-k-d77094cb.en: Here we are — give it a try!

w5-k-0d12e5c2.en: To the stop — we’ll ride there!

w5-k-fce1d40b.en: Let’s sit and take in the view.

w5-a-f6168ad1.zh: 想当一回叮当车司机吗？拉闸、松闸，还要摇铃！
w5-a-f6168ad1.en: Want to be the gripman? Grip, let go, and ring the bell!

w5-a-2344395c.zh: 上坡抓紧缆绳，看到红色就松开！
w5-a-2344395c.en: Grip the cable uphill, and let go at the red!

w5-a-c2c286b1.zh: 前面是加州街路口，松开缆绳滑过去！
w5-a-c2c286b1.en: California Street ahead: drop the rope and coast!

w5-a-145988d4.zh: 要转弯了，松开缆绳滑过去！
w5-a-145988d4.en: A corner: let go and coast round!

w5-a-96c9bbc3.en: A perfect let-go! Coast on through!

w5-a-00bdef59.zh: 警报！松晚了，下次早一点～
w5-a-00bdef59.en: The alarm! Let go a bit sooner next time.

w5-a-d036bc6b.en: Made it! Take the rope again!

w5-a-61c180e4.en: Let go, brake, and a smooth stop!

w5-a-c37a8eb0.zh: 进站前要先松开缆绳哦！
w5-a-c37a8eb0.en: Let go of the cable before the stop!

w5-a-c189fab9.zh: 上坡要抓紧，不然车会往下溜！
w5-a-c189fab9.en: Hold tight uphill, or we’ll roll back!

w5-a-42f65f9f.en: No need to ring all the time!

w5-a-c9a9c4b2.zh: 海德街这段坡有百分之二十一，是叮当车最陡的一段！
w5-a-c9a9c4b2.en: This bit of Hyde is a 21% grade: the steepest on the line!

w5-a-52d1ffc3.zh: 你是真正的叮当车司机！

w5-a-f1002ae5.zh: 开得不错！下次再开一趟！
w5-a-f1002ae5.en: Nice driving! Let’s do another run!

w5-a-0b092526.zh: 街下面的缆绳一直在跑，每小时九点五英里！
w5-a-0b092526.en: The cable under the street never stops: nine and a half miles an hour!

w5-a-1079d14f.zh: 真的鲍威尔线叮当车，过加州街都要松开缆绳滑过去。
w5-a-1079d14f.en: Real Powell cars drop the rope to coast across California Street.

w5-a-2f693b59.zh: 拉闸要用全身的力气，叮当车司机真的很厉害！
w5-a-2f693b59.en: Gripping takes real strength and coordination. Grips are amazing!

w5-a-529b6223.zh: 海特街的街头艺人！拿个铃鼓一起合奏？
w5-a-529b6223.en: A Haight Street busker! Grab a tambourine and jam?

w5-a-39f33bd2.zh: 24 街的吉他手！拿对沙锤一起合奏？
w5-a-39f33bd2.en: A 24th Street guitarist! Grab some maracas and jam?

w5-a-3e5b9d08.zh: 街头艺人下午才来哦，下午再来！
w5-a-3e5b9d08.en: The busker plays in the afternoon. Come back then!

w5-a-02080b3a.zh: 跟着节拍，圆点碰到圈就拍！
w5-a-02080b3a.en: Follow the beat: tap as each dot meets the ring!

w5-a-c0b0dc0b.zh: 节奏感真好！路人都在点头！
w5-a-c0b0dc0b.en: Great groove! People are nodding along!

w5-a-22ab87f6.en: Easy now, listen for the beat.

w5-a-4d43f1a8.en: Here comes the chorus: add some flair!

w5-a-34168bbe.zh: 一曲结束！大家都在鼓掌！

w5-a-6f8ae84a.zh: 你们简直就是一支乐队！
w5-a-6f8ae84a.en: You two sound like a real band!

w5-a-ab9b375c.zh: 1967 年的“爱之夏”，十万年轻人涌进了海特街一带。
w5-a-ab9b375c.en: In the 1967 Summer of Love, up to 100,000 young people came to the Haight.

w5-a-aea29261.zh: 24 街是拉丁文化区，旧金山壁画最多的地方！
w5-a-aea29261.en: 24th Street is the Latino Cultural District, with the most murals in the city!

w5-a-4aa60f8a.zh: 南塔的雾笛就在头顶！来玩雾笛对答？
w5-a-4aa60f8a.en: The south tower’s foghorns are right above us! Call and answer?

w5-a-3ae267bd.zh: 先听雾笛，再照着吹一遍！长音要按住！
w5-a-3ae267bd.en: Listen to the horns, then blow them back! Hold for a long one!

w5-a-a9d45add.en: Spot on! The ships heard you!

w5-a-be5780ec.zh: 雾更浓了，雾笛也更长了！
w5-a-be5780ec.en: The fog’s thicker, and the calls get longer!

w5-a-402a365d.zh: 你是金门大桥的雾笛手！
w5-a-402a365d.en: You’re the Golden Gate’s foghorn keeper!

w5-a-2dbc29a0.en: The fog lifts, and every ship is safely in!

w5-a-6f4acec9.zh: 南塔的雾笛吹两秒，再停十八秒。
w5-a-6f4acec9.en: The south tower horn: a two-second blast, then eighteen seconds of quiet.

w5-a-ebf7391f.zh: 桥中间的雾笛一次吹两声，两声音调不一样！
w5-a-ebf7391f.en: The mid-span horns blow twice, each in its own tone!

w5-a-feb3d947.zh: 起雾的时候，是桥上的工作人员手动打开雾笛的。
w5-a-feb3d947.en: When the fog rolls in, bridge workers switch the horns on by hand.

w8h-costume-pumpkin-bow.zh: 鹈鹕戴上南瓜领结啦，好神气！
w8h-costume-pumpkin-bow.en: Our pelican’s wearing a pumpkin bow tie — how dapper!

w8-h-chinatown-contest.zh: 小朋友们排队上台比变装啦！大家都好可爱～
w8-h-chinatown-contest.en: The kids are lining up for the costume contest — everyone looks so cute!

w8-h-chinatown-lanterns.zh: 红灯笼配南瓜，这就是唐人街的万圣节！
w8-h-chinatown-lanterns.en: Red lanterns and pumpkins — that’s Halloween in Chinatown!

w8-h-procession-aside.zh: 队伍从我们身边绕过去了。我们站到路边吧～
w8-h-procession-aside.en: They’re walking around us — let’s step onto the sidewalk.

w5-w2-8c0a3f3e.zh: 看海里！冲浪的人坐在板上等浪呢。
w5-w2-8c0a3f3e.en: Look out there — surfers sitting on their boards, waiting for a wave!

w5-w2-9844f094.zh: 海洋海滩浪大水冷，只有老练的冲浪手才下水。
w5-w2-9844f094.en: Ocean Beach has big waves and cold water — only experienced surfers go out.

w5-w2-f14792e8.zh: 旧金山的冲浪，上世纪四十年代就是从这片凯利湾开始的。
w5-w2-f14792e8.en: San Francisco surfing began right here at Kelly's Cove, back in the 1940s.

w5-w2-db9c6280.zh: 那几块礁石叫海豹岩，海狮会爬上去休息。
w5-w2-db9c6280.en: Those rocks are Seal Rocks — sea lions climb up there to rest.

w5-w2-a9ea6146.zh: 礁石顶上白白的，是鸬鹚留下的鸟粪！
w5-w2-a9ea6146.en: See the white on top? That's cormorant guano!

realsf-parade-day.zh: 今天上午十一点有舰船巡游，从金门大桥下开进湾里，去码头绿地看吧！
realsf-parade-day.en: At 11 this morning the Parade of Ships sails in under the Golden Gate — let’s watch from Marina Green!

realsf-parade-now.zh: 舰船巡游开始啦，船队正沿着海边开向海湾大桥！
realsf-parade-now.en: The Parade of Ships is on — the ships are sailing along the shore to the Bay Bridge!

realsf-parade-near.zh: 看，领头的消防船一边开一边喷水！打开拍照，把船队拍下来吧～
realsf-parade-near.en: Look — the fireboat leads the way, spraying water! Open the camera and get the ships in a shot!

realsf-parade-photo.zh: 船队拍到啦，舰船巡游纪念章收好！
realsf-parade-photo.en: Got the ships! A Parade of Ships stamp for your journal!
